title: deedglass.transfer/1 TRANSFER v1
$comment: Closed schema for the signed intent (spec 20_ section 5). The signed bytes must also be the exact RFC 8785 (JCS) form, contain only integers with magnitude <= 2^53-1, no duplicate keys and no lone surrogates; those rules are enforced by internal/intent before this schema applies. Cross-field rules not expressible here: exp > iat and exp - iat <= 300000.

kid.description: Lowercase hex of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(raw 32-byte public key)

aud.description: Target deployment_id (UUID generated at install); prevents cross-database replay

bundle.description: Hash of the Operation Bundle manifest the principal signs

nonce.description: 128 bits from a CSPRNG, lowercase hex

amount.description: Integer minor units as a string; never a JSON number

agent.description: Workload or agent identity; informational only in V0
